title: [IMPROVED] Report stalled flow control on mirrors/sources
body:
A source/mirror stream could stall if its flow control messages weren't making its way back to the stream being sourced/mirrored. Usually that happens with missing `$JS.FC.>` import/export. This PR improves awareness by letting a stalled error show up in stream info and print a warn log. Either way, this condition will remain until the user fixes their imports/exports.

Relates to https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/issues/8630
